title: SharedWorker WebSocket Shields Bypass
description: Tests whether a WebSocket opened inside a frameless worker (SharedWorker or ServiceWorker) bypasses Brave Shields network filtering. Brave only intercepts WebSockets when Chromium supplies a non-null RenderFrameHost, so a frameless worker socket skips BraveProxyingWebSocket and the adblock engines. The same endpoint is opened from the page, a dedicated worker, a shared worker, and a service worker; with a matching custom filter, the page and dedicated worker are blocked while the shared and service workers connect.
